newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT- Furman reiterates Fore buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT- Furman reiterates Fore buy.

text.p: -- Furman Selz analyst Martin Pykkonnen reiterated his buy rating on Fore Systems Inc, saying that the stock is currently trading at a 33 percent discount to its fiscal 1998 and long-term sustainable earnings per share growth rate.
-- He said Wall Street's near-term concerns over the back- end loaded current quarter are reflected in the stock price.
-- Pykkonen said he continues to believe there is a 10 to 15 percent upside potential to his fiscal 1998 year earnings estimate of $0.81 per share.
-- He reiterated his 12-month price target of $50.
-- The stock was up one to 23-1/2 in early Monday trading.
